h1: CNC milling vs turning vs 5-axis machining: how to choose
blocks: A 3D model and the controlling 2D drawing revision.

A shaft or sleeve will usually start with turning. A housing with pockets and flat mounting faces is more likely to need milling. Angled features or access to several faces may call for a multi-axis setup. Some parts need a combination; send the drawing so we can review the sequence.

A shaft with cross-holes, a turned fitting with milled flats or a housing with angled faces may need more than one operation or setup. The route should preserve the relationships between critical features. Send a 3D model and controlled 2D drawing so the team can review datums, access and inspection together.

h1: Planning CNC parts for prototypes and repeat orders
blocks: Compare milled pockets and housings with turned shafts and fittings. Some designs need both operations; the geometry determines the process choice.
Custom CNC machining in Hangzhou, China.

Explain the purpose of the prototype. You may need to check assembly fit and access, assess appearance or run a functional test. Agree on the checks needed for revision or approval. If the design changes, issue a revised drawing with the affected dimensions identified; an email description alone is not enough.

For a housing or shaft, the surfaces that meet other parts matter as much as the outside shape. The same applies to a mounting block. Mark the surfaces that locate, seal, slide or carry load on the drawing so you can discuss tolerances in relation to their function.

blocks: AI-generated illustrative image. Not an LZZ order, inspection or measurement record.

Agree on inspection and documentation requirements before ordering. Ask LZZ to confirm the measurement method, instrument range, calibration evidence and availability of any project-specific records required for your part.
Any required material documentation and whether substitutes may be considered.
Custom CNC machining in Hangzhou, China.
Customer or industry standards and certificates required for this part or program.
Download the order acceptance checklist to record the drawing revision, critical features, documents and shipping requirements in one place. This is a buyer worksheet, not an inspection report.
Exact alloy or polymer grade, or the functional requirement if selection is still open.
Finish specification, appearance, cosmetic faces, masking and edge conditions.

For an existing sample without a drawing, explain what is known and ask what additional measurement or design work would be needed. Do not assume the sample communicates hidden material or treatment requirements.

Identify mating bores and shaft fits on the drawing, with their datums and tolerances. Mark sealing faces, threads and any other critical features too. State whether dimensions apply before or after finishing. If you need a particular inspection record, send the format or an example with your inquiry.
If your project needs an NDA or a controlled transfer method, contact LZZ before sending restricted files. An NDA is not automatically created by using this website.

Include a 3D model, such as STEP, and a 2D drawing when dimensions, fits or surface requirements are not fully defined in the model. Label the part number, units and drawing revision. If the files disagree, identify which document controls before requesting a quotation. For multi-axis parts, include the overall envelope, stock dimensions and part weight where known so tool access and setup can be reviewed.
Mark the dimensions used for acceptance
No. 4 Fengcheng Road Pingyao, Yuhang District Hangzhou, Zhejiang, China
Orders start at 1 piece. Give the initial quantity by part number and, if known, the expected repeat-order pattern so LZZ can quote the right price and batch plan.

Our quotation brings together the proposed process, material, finishing, order quantity, inspection documents, production schedule and shipping basis. Where geometry or acceptance requirements need clarification, we identify the open points before you approve production.
Send your drawing, material and quantity so we can review the part and prepare a quote.

State the required arrival date, delivery postcode and packaging needs. Production takes 7–14 business days after drawing and order confirmation, including surface finishing; transit is separate. Specify the Incoterm and customs, duty or tax responsibilities. If you have a decision or response deadline, include it in your inquiry. These details are confirmed for each order.

State the required standard, revision and scope. A material or capability category on this site does not establish industry certification or application compliance. The material and finish checklist explains the decisions behind these fields.
The inquiry page prepares an email draft locally. It does not upload drawings or send a request. Attach your files in your email application, review the recipients and send when ready.
Use these examples to see the shapes and drawing questions discussed above. Each custom part still needs its own drawing and quote.

Product pages show a catalog image; the image is not an inspection record or a specification document. Original workshop photographs and company documents are identified separately from product examples.

Product pages use shorter titles and summaries of the catalog entries. The original names remain available on those pages, and the source material is kept in our archive. The summaries are not independently verified specifications for the photographed parts. Confirm material grades and tolerances with the team, along with the inspection and commercial terms for your order.

The engineering guides help you prepare an inquiry; they are not inspection records or customer case studies. They do not establish suitability for a particular application. Material filters help you find existing parts without creating duplicate product pages. English descriptions of company documents explain their contents but do not verify current validity.

The form creates an email draft in your browser. It does not send your information to LZZ or upload drawings. To contact us, open the draft in your email app, add your attachments and send it yourself.

The form saves your input and draft status in the current tab using sessionStorage, with a separate entry for each selected part. Your details stay available after a refresh but are not saved to an account or sent to LZZ. Select "Clear saved input" to remove the entry for the current part.
This site does not use analytics or advertising cookies. Your email provider, WhatsApp and other linked websites have their own privacy policies.

Your browser may restore this data when it restores a previous session. Clear your input before leaving a shared device. If browser storage is blocked or full, you can still use the form while the page is open. Select "Save draft" to download a text copy.
